panels.description: Three marked tables read KEEL, HALYARD and OASIS. Each has three temporary representatives; show only a few distinct figures, none requiring individual recognition. Leave upper space.
At the Keel table, Tomas reads a stamped instruction strip and folds it closed. Leave upper area for the record.
The public allocation sheet reads COMMUNITY SUPPLY: 420 UNITS and APPROVAL PENDING. Keep the sheet unobstructed.
Tomas places the Measure beside the allocation sheet while the other Keel representatives look toward the physical gauge outside frame. Leave upper-left for his line.

items.speaker: TOMAS
items.text: Before we approve, show us the units.
